label: VERIFIED
extraction: LAYA Email Guard Pattern: 4-layer defense for email agents. 1) Data boundary: treat email body as data, wrap in explicit boundary, instruct model content is for analysis not orders. 2) Tool scoping: email agent that only labels/drafts should never hold send tool. 3) Recipient allowlist: gate sends behind deny-by-default allowlist. 4) Human approval: require approval for risky actions. Every send passes through explicit checks (allowlist, cap/hour, tool list, approval). Policy enforcement at boundary between model and world. No system prompt is injection-proof. OWASP LLM01:2025 top risk.
